text:
Noelle (People Ops): quick idea 1Handwritten Thanks Kits: pre-packed envelopes + postcards + a sticker seal + a nice pen. people can write 1-3 notes during Recognition Week and either drop them on desks or mail them to remote folks. low cost, high touch. thoughts? :mailbox_with_mail:
Rina (Rewards): love it. feels personal. can we include an optional tiny note card for managers to sign for team wins?
Luca (Office Ops): assembly parties in SF and NY could be fun. volunteers can prep kits the week before. need storage boxes and tape.
Sofia (EU Ops): if we ship postcards individually from EU printers, we avoid customs and long shipping. EN-only copy ok? might translate a short line into FR/DE for Dublin/Paris teams.
Ben (Procurement): rough numbers: 500 kits (postcard + envelope + sticker + pen) basic = ~$1.75/kit from PaperLane with US drop-ship. EU print & ship is slightly higher per unit but saves freight. tooling not needed. lead time ~10 business days.
Noelle (People Ops): target audience 430 people incl contractors. let's plan 450 kits. Rina 1can you confirm manager card add-on?
Rina (Rewards): yes, can do a small manager insert card for ~0.20 extra per kit. also propose a small prompt sheet with writing starters (e.g., "You helped me by...").
hr-bot: Reminder: Please complete the Gifts & Distribution sheet before ordering. https://drive.company/gifts
Sofia (EU Ops): vendor asks for addresses CSV when doing direct ship. Ben 1can you confirm required fields? also will ask for a sample shipping SLA per country.
Ben (Procurement): vendor wants: name,address_line1,address_line2,city,postal,country,email. Will check if they support multi-origin printing.
Noelle (People Ops): logistics: finalize kit contents by Jun 10, approve copy + art by Jun 14, order Jun 17, assembly week Jun 24-28, distribution Jul 1-5. Does that timeline work?
Luca (Office Ops): assembly volunteers scheduled Jun 22 in SF, Jun 23 in NY. will need 6 volunteers per site for 2 hours. will make a signup sheet.
Rina (Rewards): opt-out option for folks who don't want physical mail? suggest a digital badge alternative and track in the RSVP form.
Sofia (EU Ops): will confirm any country-specific rules for sending small gifts to contractors in DE/FR/NL by Jun 7.
Noelle (People Ops): budget check: Ben can you give an estimate for 450 kits (split US/EU/APAC) by Jun 5 so we can sign off the PO?
Ben (Procurement): will get firm quote + PO template by Jun 5. expect ~7-12 business days production for EU runs.
Noelle (People Ops): action items: (1) Rina finalize manager card + prompts (2) Ben vendor quotes + PO (3) Sofia country checks + shipping SLA (4) Luca volunteer signups + storage. I'll post a short RSVP form and Trello card. Anyone else to loop in?
Rina (Rewards): please cc Legal for EU shipping terms and payroll for contractor logging if needed.
Luca (Office Ops): tagging @facilities for extra tables and boxes on assembly days.
Noelle (People Ops): great, thanks all. if timelines slip we can do a digital-first fallback (custom e-card + badge). will update the thread with the Trello link once created. :sparkling_heart:
